metadata.credits: Guest subjects quoted from this edition: Fugue I (C major), II (C minor), IV (C-sharp minor), V (D major), VIII (E-flat minor; its head is J. S. Bach, WTC I/8, BWV 853). Fugue I's canon at the octave three eighths apart is its own rung R3.
